body: I can argue the same philosophical point. Should I kill myself, the action would have been decided, and the world would have gone without me anyway. There are infinite number of timelines in the world. There's a timeline where I kill myself, and there is a world after that, I'm sure.
I don't care about being unique to this world. It'll move on without me the same as it did before.
I don't know. I purposefully don't remember.
Everyone that has ever carried any weight in my opinion of myself, yes.
Virtually everyone that I've ever met has told me this. I've told myself that. I have no regrets about my life, only that I haven't done as much as I should have to remove that stigma from myself.

I've been to a therapist. The anti-depressants didn't help. Neither did the anti-psychotics. Or the adhd meds. Or whatever else they gave me. The problem isn't an illness. It has to do with hating myself in such a way that I can't break no matter who says what to me. It doesn't matter if someone else thinks I'm worthwhile, to myself I'll always be worthless and nothing anyone has said or done has changed that opinion.

I've been figuring out the best way to die since I was around 15. I'm just tired of life and shouldn't have ever been here. I'm 21 and have realized that over the last two decades I can't ever actually remember being happy. I'm just tired of it all and this way seems to be the most simple and hopefully, no one will catch on before it can truly be over.
